source_quote: Cambridge-based startup Neela Biotech has raised £2.1m in pre-seed funding to scale its AI-driven technology that converts food, agricultural and forestry waste into sustainable aviation fuel (SAF).

source_quote: 当时，WeWork 的私募市场估值曾达到 470 亿美元（现汇率约合 3,154.61 亿元人民币），但在 New Constructs 那份报告发布仅六周后，由于需求疲软以及围绕其财务状况的激烈批评，该公司撤回了 IPO。
